title: 4 Days of Iteration Compilation
author: PykeTheTitan
selftext:
It seems like everyone is trying to one shot the best game but my perspective was that the true power of ai is just that it can reduce the time it takes to iterate, and truly great art gets made with tons of iteration. 4 days of working with GPT 5.6 Sol, mostly on medium. Believe it or not a lot of stuff was still left out, some bugs that I got at some point that just didn't add to the progression I was trying to show in this video. 

This is still far for how fluid I want the combat system to be, but good enough to proceed to try to build an entire gameplay loop before I start spending time refining things slowly. I have a really ambitious project in mind and I'm just having fun vibe developing. 

Art is one thing I'm concerned about, I think I'm going to have to wait for models to get a little bit better before I can create the custom 3d models that live up to the standard of art I want so I'm just working on functionality.
